scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,SOCKET,ADMIN -c green,cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm --filter socket start" "pnpm dev:admin"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter socket test && pnpm --filter socket exec tsx --test ../../packages/ui/src/locale.test.ts ../web/tests/analytics.test.ts ../web/tests/launch-hardening.test.ts && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm test:server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --incremental false -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/socket/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter 2048-admin typecheck
scripts.test:server: pnpm --filter socket exec tsx --test ../web/tests/collection.test.ts ../web/tests/achievement-operations.test.ts && node --test apps/web/tests/server-pages.test.mjs apps/web/tests/server-boundaries.test.mjs apps/web/tests/public-catalog-cache.test.mjs apps/web/tests/collection-pages.test.mjs apps/web/tests/achievement-server.test.mjs apps/web/tests/game-server-pages.test.mjs apps/admin/tests/server-pages.test.mjs
